title: Cannabinoid and Terpenoid Extraction and Analysis
author: Richard D. Richins
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.rd4d28w

steps.title: Homogenize sample in acetone
steps.instruction: Weigh cured/dried flowers or dried leaves and homogenize them in 20 mL of reagent‑grade acetone using a Polytron Homogenizer (Kinematica).

steps.title: Shake homogenate
steps.instruction: Transfer the homogenates to suitable tubes and place them on an orbital shaker for 1 hour.

steps.title: Dilute samples with internal standards
steps.instruction: Dilute each sample with four parts acetone that contains 1 mg/mL chlorophenol (internal standard 1, ISS1) and 2 mg/mL phenacetin (internal standard 2, ISS2).

steps.title: Centrifuge to remove insoluble matter
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the diluted samples briefly (no specific time given) to pellet insoluble material; collect the supernatant for analysis.

steps.title: Perform GC‑FID analysis
steps.instruction: Inject 2.0 µL of the cleared supernatant (split ratio 10) into a Varian model 3900 GC‑FID equipped with an Rxi‑35 column (15 m × 0.25 mm). Use ultrapure nitrogen as carrier gas at 1 mL/min. Set injector temperature to 250 °C and FID temperature to 300 °C. Run the following temperature program: start at 45 °C, hold 1 min; increase at 10 °C/min to 240 °C; increase at 4 °C/min to 280 °C; increase at 20 °C/min to 290 °C, hold 1 min.

substeps.instruction: Set carrier gas (ultrapure nitrogen) flow to 1 mL/min.
Configure injector: 2.0 µL injection volume, split 10, temperature 250 °C.
Program oven temperature: 45 °C (1 min hold) → 240 °C at 10 °C/min → 280 °C at 4 °C/min → 290 °C at 20 °C/min (1 min hold).
